b082: The tool: Uridine monophosphate (UMP). There's no study showing that "UMP cures DAWS", only more basic research on what uridine, choline, and DHA do in the brain. All three get carried in the blood to the brain, which uses them to make the fatty membranes at its synapses (circulating precursors for brain phosphatide / synaptic membrane synthesis). Wurtman's research group found that giving the three together can build up the synapses' membranes and proteins, and that in animals, UMP made DHA better at getting neurons to grow new connection points, which they call DHA-induced dendritic spine formation. They also fed UMP to old rats, and the rats' neurons released more dopamine when they were stimulated with potassium, and grew more nerve fibers. So it's plausible it works on the synapses this way, but for DAWS in people, all we have is a cautious extrapolation from those studies, plus anecdotes like Scott's.
b083: Scott added a standard dose of UMP, and within a day his ketamine/LSD cravings fell hard. He already had choline covered with eggs, and took fish oil for DHA/EPA. His psychedelic tolerance seemed to drop too. You can't tell from this whether UMP rebuilt his D3 receptors overnight. It does suggest that in the right person, UMP can show you very clearly when the brain's system for rebuilding synaptic membranes and recovering dopamine receptors has been starved of building materials. Scott was having vivid dreams again too, with real childhood memories coming back in them.
